title: Hypers at ComMA@ICON: Modelling Aggressiveness, Gender Bias and Communal Bias Identification

bias_targets.methodology: Classifying code-mixed, multilingual social media sentences as gendered or non-gendered by finetuning pretrained transformer models (MURIL and BanglaBert) with attention and mean pooling.

Classifying code-mixed, multilingual social media sentences as communal or non-communal (targeting a particular religion or caste) by finetuning pretrained transformer models (MURIL and BanglaBert) with attention and mean pooling.
